label: Test: 7-Zip from a bundled installer (CI only)
description: Hidden test item. Installs 7-Zip from an installer file that ships inside the download (no internet needed), checked against its pinned fingerprint before it runs.
notes: Proves the bundled source on windows-latest. Installer: official 7z2603-x64.exe, committed as tests/assets/7z2603-x64.exe; SHA-256 matches www.7-zip.org and the winget-pkgs manifest for 7zip.7zip 26.03. Not Authenticode-signed, so SHA-256 only. NSIS: /S installs silently; Uninstall.exe /S removes it (detached, polled until gone).
